summary: Natural Gas Services Group filed an 8-K on May 11, 2026, reporting Q1 2026 financial results and announcing a $0.15/share cash dividend, payable June 3, 2026 to holders of record May 20. The filing is a routine earnings release under Item 2.02 and a dividend declaration under Item 8.01. No acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, strategic review, tender offer, going-private transaction, or other special situation is disclosed. The dividend increase is a capital return but not a transformative special-situation event. This is an ordinary quarterly update for a going concern.
